> **Depends on #60149** ([Model] Add Dory support, by @shan18, still open). This branch is #60149's head plus **one commit**; please review only that commit: [8101656](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63150/commits/810165601bc7d1c4d5658ff1c1fc8a0a25899a9a). The full diff below includes #60149 until it lands; I will rebase onto main then. Tracking issue: #63152.

## Overview

Dory is a looped model: a shared block runs `n_recurrent_loops` times per token, and more loops trade latency for reasoning depth. Today the count is fixed per engine. This PR lets each request pick its count:

```python
SamplingParams(..., extra_args={"loops": 3})                                  # offline
client.chat.completions.create(..., extra_body={"vllm_xargs": {"loops": 3}})  # OpenAI server
```

with the engine started as `--hf-overrides '{"n_recurrent_loops": 2, "max_recurrent_loops": 3}'`. `n_recurrent_loops` stays the default.

## Claims

- A request with `loops=N` produces the same tokens and logprobs as an engine started with `n_recurrent_loops=N`, alone and inside a batch that mixes counts (batch-invariant mode).
- A step costs the largest count in its batch: a mixed {1,2,3} batch runs at the speed of a pure 3-loop batch.
- Without `max_recurrent_loops` nothing changes for other models, and Dory's speed is unchanged within 0.5%.
- Requests with different counts never share prefix-cache blocks. Out-of-range values return a 400 error.

## Validation

1x H100 80GB, this branch on a precompiled build of #60149's main merge base, Dory1.0-4B BF16.

**Tests**
```
$ pytest -q tests/transformers_utils/test_dory_config.py tests/models/test_dory.py
45 passed
$ VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 pytest -v tests/models/language/generation/test_dory_per_request_loops.py
test_per_request_loops_match_fixed_servers PASSED      # loops=1..3 alone and in one mixed batch == fixed-N engines (tokens + logprobs)
test_prefix_cache_is_not_shared_across_loop_counts PASSED
2 passed in 502s
```
The GPU test is picked up by the nightly "Language Models (Extended Generation)" step. `ruff check` / `ruff format` pass on the touched files.

**Throughput** (offline `LLM.generate`, 128-token random prompts, 256 output tokens, `ignore_eos`, output tok/s, 3 runs per cell; all configurations ran in one job on the same GPU):

| config | requests | c=1 | c=8 | c=32 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #60149 head, `n_recurrent_loops=2` | default | 146.7 / 146.8 / 146.7 | 1114 / 1117 / 1119 | 3979 / 3995 / 3987 |
| same, rerun at the end | default | 146.8 / 146.9 / 146.8 | 1120 / 1120 / 1120 | 3965 / 3975 / 3958 |
| this PR, no `max_recurrent_loops` | default | 146.4 / 146.4 / 146.4 | 1114 / 1116 / 1119 | 3960 / 3969 / 3975 |
| this PR, `max_recurrent_loops=3` | default (2) | 146.3 / 146.3 / 146.3 | 1119 / 1114 / 1118 | 3973 / 3981 / 3978 |
| | `loops=1` | 221.2 / 221.2 / 221.3 | 1675 / 1688 / 1689 | 6002 / 5942 / 5968 |
| | `loops=3` | 109.3 / 109.3 / 109.3 | 836 / 835 / 836 | 2976 / 2969 / 2966 |
| | mixed 1/2/3 | n/a | 834 / 835 / 834 | 2968 / 2961 / 2964 |
| one pass per count (previous revision of this PR) | mixed 1/2/3 | n/a | 386 / 386 / 386 | 1375 / 1370 / 1370 |

The default path costs 0.2% at c=1 (one opaque state-update op per loop) and is within run-to-run spread at c=8/32.

## Details

**Model** (`dory.py`). There is one compiled unit for each largest count m = 1..`max_recurrent_loops`. Unit m runs m loops. Loop i's state update is a custom op, `vllm::dory_loop_state`, that keeps the state of tokens whose count is ≤ i. The op is opaque to torch.compile on purpose. With the select inlined, Inductor fused it into the neighbouring nGPT norm reductions, so a mixed batch rounded differently from a fixed-count engine and greedy outputs diverged after about 40 tokens. With the op, the code around it compiles identically in every unit, and every token is bit-identical to its fixed-count engine. Each unit has its own forward qualname, which the AOT compile cache is keyed on. All units are compiled during the profiling run, so they get the same Inductor size hints as a fixed-count engine.

**Per-request state** (`DoryModelState`, via the existing `get_model_state_cls` hook) reads `extra_args["loops"]` in `add_request`. In `prepare_inputs` it fills a persistent per-token count buffer and selects the unit for the batch's largest count.

**Core changes** (about 45 lines, opt-in):
- `ModelState.cudagraph_variants()` / `ModelState.cudagraph_variant`. FULL CUDA graphs are baked to one unit, so `ModelCudaGraphManager` captures them once per variant and replays the current batch's variant. The default is a single variant (`None`), which takes the unchanged path, and `model_runner.py` is not touched. Dory has `max_recurrent_loops` variants (3 here). The FULL-graph memory estimate in `profile_cudagraph_memory` is multiplied by the variant count. Batch-dependent depth with FULL graphs needs one graph per depth; a single max-depth graph would make `loops=1` cost as much as the max.
- `InputProcessor`: an optional `hf_config.request_cache_salt(extra_args, cache_salt)` hook. Prefix-cache hashes do not cover `extra_args`, and loop-k KV is only written up to the batch's largest count, so a block written at one count is not valid at another. The hook appends `dory-loops=N` to the request's salt for non-default counts and validates the value at admission (400). Relying on clients to set `cache_salt` themselves would silently corrupt outputs when they forget.

**Limitations**
- With `per_loop` KV, the per-loop caches are allocated for `max_recurrent_loops` for every request. KV capacity therefore scales with the max, not the default. `last_loop` KV mode is rejected together with per-request counts.
- Engine start compiles one unit per count and captures FULL graphs per count. Startup and CUDA graph memory grow linearly with `max_recurrent_loops`.
- Model Runner V2 only. On V1 the field is validated, but every request runs the default count.
- Tensor parallel size 1 only, as in #60149.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Per-request Dory loop counts (SamplingParams.extra_args["loops"]).
+
+A request with ``loops=N`` must produce exactly what a server started with
+``n_recurrent_loops=N`` produces, alone and inside a batch that mixes loop
+counts. Exact equality needs batch-invariant kernels (VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1).
+"""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm import SamplingParams
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from ...registry import HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS
+
+MODEL = HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS.get_hf_info("DoryForCausalLM").default
+PROMPTS = [
+    "Explain in three sentences why the sky is blue.",
+    "Which team should handle a double charge on a card: billing or shipping?",
+    "Write a Python function that returns the n-th Fibonacci number.",
+    "What is 17 * 23? Show your work.",
+]
+MAX_LOOPS = 3
+COMMON = dict(max_model_len=1024, max_num_seqs=16, dtype="bfloat16")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="per-request loops need CUDA graphs"
+)
+
+
+def _params(loops: int | None) -> SamplingParams:
+    return SamplingParams(
+        temperature=0.0,
+        max_tokens=48,
+        logprobs=0,
+        extra_args=None if loops is None else {"loops": loops},
+    )
+
+
+def _run(llm, jobs: list[tuple[int, int | None]], together: bool):
+    """Jobs = [(prompt index, loops)] -> {(prompt index, loops): (ids, logprobs)}"""
+    out = {}
+    batches = [jobs] if together else [[j] for j in jobs]
+    for batch in batches:
+        llm.llm.reset_prefix_cache()
+        res = llm.llm.generate(
+            [PROMPTS[i] for i, _ in batch], [_params(n) for _, n in batch]
+        )
+        for (i, n), r in zip(batch, res):
+            c = r.outputs[0]
+            lps = [lp[t].logprob for lp, t in zip(c.logprobs, c.token_ids)]
+            out[(i, n)] = (list(c.token_ids), lps)
+    return out
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def batch_invariant(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", "1")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("batch_invariant")
+def test_per_request_loops_match_fixed_servers(vllm_runner):
+    prompts = range(len(PROMPTS))
+    fixed = {}
+    for n in range(1, MAX_LOOPS + 1):
+        overrides = {"n_recurrent_loops": n}
+        with vllm_runner(MODEL, hf_overrides=overrides, **COMMON) as llm:
+            for (i, _), v in _run(llm, [(i, None) for i in prompts], False).items():
+                fixed[(i, n)] = v
+
+    jobs = [(i, n) for i in prompts for n in range(1, MAX_LOOPS + 1)]
+    overrides = {"n_recurrent_loops": 2, "max_recurrent_loops": MAX_LOOPS}
+    with vllm_runner(MODEL, hf_overrides=overrides, **COMMON) as llm:
+        alone = _run(llm, jobs, together=False)
+        # interleaved loop counts in one batch: the graph of the largest count
+        mixed = _run(llm, jobs, together=True)
+        default = _run(llm, [(i, None) for i in prompts], together=False)
+    for key in jobs:
+        assert alone[key] == fixed[key], f"alone {key}"
+        assert mixed[key] == fixed[key], f"mixed batch {key}"
+    for i in prompts:
+        assert default[(i, None)] == fixed[(i, 2)]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("batch_invariant")
+def test_prefix_cache_is_not_shared_across_loop_counts(vllm_runner):
+    overrides = {"n_recurrent_loops": 2, "max_recurrent_loops": MAX_LOOPS}
+    with vllm_runner(MODEL, hf_overrides=overrides, **COMMON) as llm:
+        cold = _run(llm, [(0, 3)], together=False)[(0, 3)]
+        llm.llm.reset_prefix_cache()
+        # prompt 0 at the default count fills the prefix cache ...
+        llm.llm.generate([PROMPTS[0]], [_params(2)])
+        # ... which a 3-loop request must not reuse
+        res = llm.llm.generate([PROMPTS[0]], [_params(3)])[0].outputs[0]
+        lps = [lp[t].logprob for lp, t in zip(res.logprobs, res.token_ids)]
+    assert (list(res.token_ids), lps) == cold

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CPU checks of Dory math and loading, with a reference attention backend."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from huggingface_hub.errors import StrictDataclassClassValidationError
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import (
+    CompilationConfig,
+    DeviceConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+    set_current_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.distributed import parallel_state
+from vllm.model_executor.models import dory
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import extract_layer_index
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.dory import DoryConfig
+
+
+class ReferenceAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Single-request causal GQA, including sliding-window and decode caching."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_heads, head_size, scale, num_kv_heads, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_heads, self.num_kv_heads = num_heads, num_kv_heads
+        self.head_size, self.scale = head_size, scale
+        self.prefix = kwargs["prefix"]
+        self.window = kwargs["per_layer_sliding_window"]
+        self.keys = self.values = None
+
+    def forward(self, q, k, v):
+        q = q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_size).transpose(0, 1)
+        k = k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size).transpose(0, 1)
+        v = v.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size).transpose(0, 1)
+        offset = self.start_pos
+        self.keys = (

+class DoryAttention(nn.Module):
+    """GQA attention with nGPT qk-norm, output gate, and fngpt justnorm."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, config, layer_idx, cache_config, quant_config, prefix, num_loops=1
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        std = config.initializer_range
+
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            self.hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.num_kv_heads,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.g_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            self.hidden_size,
+            self.q_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.g_proj",
+        )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.q_size,
+            self.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+
+        self.sqk = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.q_size))
+        self.s_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.q_size))
+        self._sqk_factor = self.head_dim**0.5 / std
+        g0 = config.attention_output_gate_logit_scale_init
+        if g0 is None:
+            g0 = config.hidden_size**0.5
+        self._s_gate_factor = g0**0.5 / std
+
+        layer_type = config.layer_types[layer_idx]
+        self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+            self.head_dim,
+            max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+            rope_parameters=config.rope_parameters[layer_type],
+            is_neox_style=True,
+        )
+
+        self.per_loop_kv = config.recurrent_kv_cache_mode == "per_loop"
+        # Match LoopCoder's virtual layer indices for independent loop caches.
+        # Projection prefixes keep the physical layer index to share weights.
+        self.attn = nn.ModuleList()
+        for loop_idx in range(num_loops if self.per_loop_kv else 1):
+            unique_layer_idx = loop_idx * config.num_hidden_layers + layer_idx
+            unique_prefix = prefix.replace(
+                f".layers.{layer_idx}.", f".layers.{unique_layer_idx}."
+            )
+            self.attn.append(
+                Attention(
+                    self.num_heads,
+                    self.head_dim,
+                    scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim),
+                    num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+                    cache_config=cache_config,
+                    quant_config=quant_config,
+                    per_layer_sliding_window=(
+                        config.sliding_window
+                        if layer_type == "sliding_attention"
+                        else None
+                    ),
+                    prefix=f"{unique_prefix}.attn",
+                )
+            )
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, loop_idx=0):
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        gate, _ = self.g_proj(hidden_states)
+
+        q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+
+        # nGPT qk-norm AFTER rope: q scaled by (sqk*f)^2 post-justnorm, k plain justnorm
+        t = q.shape[0]
+        q = q.view(t, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        sqk = (self.sqk.float() * self._sqk_factor).view(
+            1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim
+        )
+        q = (sqk.square() * justnorm(q).float()).to(q.dtype).view(t, self.q_size)
+        k = k.view(t, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        k = justnorm(k).view(t, self.kv_size)
+
+        # In last-loop mode every loop writes this step's KV to the same cache,
+        # overwriting the previous loop's. Loop i thus attends to loop-i KV for
+        # this step's tokens and last-loop KV for earlier tokens.
+        out = self.attn[loop_idx if self.per_loop_kv else 0](q, k, v)
+
+        # output gate (sigmoid, pre-o_proj), then fngpt justnorm over np*hn
+        sg = (self.s_gate.float() * self._s_gate_factor).square()
+        out = (out.float() * torch.sigmoid(gate.float() * sg)).to(out.dtype)
+        out = justnorm(out)
+        out, _ = self.o_proj(out)
+        return out

+class DoryMLP(nn.Module):
+    """SwiGLU with nGPT suv scaling and fngpt justnorm."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.ffn = config.intermediate_size
+        self.gate_up_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            [self.ffn] * 2,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate_up_proj",
+        )
+        self.down_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.ffn,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
+        )
+        self.suv_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.ffn))
+        self.suv_up = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.ffn))
+        self._suv_factor = config.hidden_size**0.5
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states):
+        m, _ = self.gate_up_proj(hidden_states)
+        g, u = m.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        g = (g.float() * (self.suv_gate.float() * self._suv_factor)).to(g.dtype)
+        u = (u.float() * (self.suv_up.float() * self._suv_factor)).to(u.dtype)
+        m = (F.silu(g.float()) * u.float()).to(m.dtype)
+        m = justnorm(m)
+        out, _ = self.down_proj(m)
+        return out
+

+class DoryDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    """One physical layer: a single sublayer (attention OR mlp) + slerp residual."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, config, layer_idx, cache_config, quant_config, prefix, num_loops=1
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.is_attention = config.layer_types[layer_idx] != "mlp"
+        self._alpha_scale = config.ngpt_alpha_init / config.initializer_range
+        if self.is_attention:
+            self.mixer = DoryAttention(
+                config,
+                layer_idx,
+                cache_config,
+                quant_config,
+                f"{prefix}.mixer",
+                num_loops=num_loops,
+            )
+            self.attn_alpha = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(config.hidden_size))
+        else:
+            self.mixer = DoryMLP(config, quant_config, f"{prefix}.mixer")
+            self.mlp_alpha = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(config.hidden_size))
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, loop_idx=0):
+        residual = hidden_states
+        if self.is_attention:
+            out = self.mixer(positions, hidden_states, loop_idx=loop_idx)
+            return slerp_alpha(residual, out, self.attn_alpha, self._alpha_scale)
+        out = self.mixer(hidden_states)
+        return slerp_alpha(residual, out, self.mlp_alpha, self._alpha_scale)

+class DoryBackbone(nn.Module):
+    """Weights + layers. Not compiled itself: the compiled units are the
+    DoryLoopVariant modules below, one per loop count."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, cache_config, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = config
+        # The per-loop KV caches are sized for the largest per-request count.
+        self.num_loops = config.max_recurrent_loops or config.n_recurrent_loops
+        n_in = config.n_input_layers
+        n_rec = config.n_recurrent_layers
+        self.embeddings = VocabParallelEmbedding(config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size)
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                DoryDecoderLayer(
+                    config,
+                    i,
+                    cache_config,
+                    quant_config,
+                    f"{prefix}.layers.{i}",
+                    num_loops=self.num_loops if n_in <= i < n_in + n_rec else 1,
+                )
+                for i in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+
+    def run(self, input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds, num_loops, loop_counts):
+        h = inputs_embeds if inputs_embeds is not None else self.embeddings(input_ids)
+        c = self.config
+        n_in, n_rec = c.n_input_layers, c.n_recurrent_layers
+
+        for layer in self.layers[:n_in]:
+            h = layer(positions, h)
+        input_h = h
+
+        state = input_h
+        for i in range(num_loops):
+            combined = justnorm(state + input_h)
+            h = combined
+            for layer in self.layers[n_in : n_in + n_rec]:
+                h = layer(positions, h, loop_idx=i)
+            state = torch.ops.vllm.dory_loop_state(justnorm(h), state, loop_counts, i)
+
+        h = state
+        for layer in self.layers[n_in + n_rec :]:
+            h = layer(positions, h)
+        return h

+def _make_loop_variant(num_loops: int):
+    """A torch.compile unit running `num_loops` loops, in which loop i only
+    updates tokens whose count is > i. Each variant needs its own forward
+    qualname: vLLM keys the AOT compile cache on it."""
+    name = f"DoryLoopVariantL{num_loops}"
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        loop_counts: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.core.run(
+            input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds, self.num_loops, loop_counts
+        )

+class DoryModelState(DefaultModelState):
+    """Per-request loop counts (``SamplingParams.extra_args["loops"]``, validated
+    and prefix-cache salted by ``DoryConfig.request_cache_salt``). A step runs
+    the graph of the largest count in its batch; tokens of smaller counts stop
+    updating after their own count, so each token matches a server started with
+    ``n_recurrent_loops`` equal to its count. FULL CUDA graphs are captured per
+    largest count (``ModelState.cudagraph_variants``)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device)
+        self.default_loops = model.config.n_recurrent_loops
+        self.req_loops = np.full(self.max_num_reqs, self.default_loops, np.int32)
+        # Persistent: FULL graphs read it in place.
+        self.loop_counts = torch.full(
+            (self.max_num_tokens,), self.default_loops, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.cudagraph_variant = self.default_loops
+
+    def add_request(self, req_index: int, new_req_data: NewRequestData) -> None:
+        super().add_request(req_index, new_req_data)
+        sp = new_req_data.sampling_params
+        loops = (sp.extra_args or {}).get("loops") if sp is not None else None
+        self.req_loops[req_index] = self.default_loops if loops is None else loops
+
+    def prepare_inputs(self, input_batch, req_states):
+        out = super().prepare_inputs(input_batch, req_states)
+        n = input_batch.num_tokens_after_padding
+        loops = self.req_loops[input_batch.idx_mapping_np]
+        top = int(loops.max())
+        if int(loops.min()) == top:
+            self.loop_counts[:n].fill_(top)
+        else:
+            per_token = np.full(n, top, dtype=np.int32)  # padding: any count
+            num = input_batch.num_scheduled_tokens[: input_batch.num_reqs]
+            per_token[: int(num.sum())] = np.repeat(loops, num)
+            async_tensor_h2d(per_token, out=self.loop_counts[:n])
+        self.cudagraph_variant = self.model.num_loops = top
+        out["loop_counts"] = self.loop_counts[:n]
+        return out
+
+    def prepare_dummy_inputs(self, num_reqs: int, num_tokens: int):
+        out = super().prepare_dummy_inputs(num_reqs, num_tokens)
+        self.model.num_loops = self.cudagraph_variant
+        self.loop_counts[:num_tokens].fill_(self.cudagraph_variant)
+        out["loop_counts"] = self.loop_counts[:num_tokens]
+        return out
+
+    def cudagraph_variants(self) -> tuple[int | None, ...]:
+        max_loops = self.model.backbone.num_loops
+        if max_loops == self.default_loops:
+            return (None,)  # no per-request counts: one graph, as for any model
+        return tuple(range(1, max_loops + 1))
